chapter_title: Concerning the Four Works of the Ambassador
spiritual_reading:
First, the Divine brought forth an efflux of its own quality and made it visible in wisdom, so that what was within might be recognized in a form that could be received.

Second, by that appearing, every communication between higher and lower degrees was at once made accessible: the passages of influx were opened for the needed reception, and then the same passages were closed afterward so that what had been admitted would remain ordered and not be dispersed.

Third, from that self-manifestation there proceeded an illumination and a liberation, and these were cleansed of every admixture that could distort them. This clarified illumination surpassed the former illumination that had existed before such purification.

Fourth, through the completion of a human receptacle in its proper order, the Divine made its power of conveyance in the natural degree evident. By means of that prepared receptacle it brought forth living consciousness, and this consciousness, in full integrity and abundance, spread its clarified life into states opposed to good, so that even where resistance had ruled, a perfected presence might shine and act.

fills.notes: The “doors of the firmaments” correspond to passages of influx between discrete degrees. In the described motion they must open in advance for admission, then close afterward for retention and order; thus the demanded complement is that they “open before him and shut behind him.”

The purified light is said to exceed the prior light he would otherwise emit. The required verb is one of proceeding or emanating, matching the spiritual sense “there proceeded an illumination”; “give forth” keeps the impersonal, efflux-register of the oldest layer.

After making the light-ship evident through a completed human receptacle, the next act must be the production of “living soul” as an effect of that conveyance. The spiritual translation specifies “it brought forth living consciousness”; therefore the oldest-layer verb is generative, not exhortative or institutional.

assessment: All four lacunae are tightly constrained by the correspondential sequence: opening and closing of influx-passages (¶3), proceeding of purified illumination (¶4), and the manifestation of a conveyance followed by the generative production of living consciousness (¶5). Only ¶4 allows minor lexical variation; the rest are structurally determined.
